name: Salesforce
outlook:
What Salesforce says to expect

  • Third quarter fiscal 2027: revenueInitiates third quarter FY27 revenue guidance of $11.42 billion to $11.5 billion, up 11% - 12% Y/Y and in CC, including slightly above 4pts Informatica contribution
  • Full year fiscal 2027: revenueSalesforce raises full year FY27 revenue guidance to $46.1 billion to $46.4 billion, up 11% - 12% Y/Y and 11% Y/Y in CC.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed August 26, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
